key_insight: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary program search using agent swarms that reason and exchange ideas in latent space rather than generating long textual reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Latent-space collaboration offers a potentially faster, lower-cost route to discovering and optimizing programs for mathematical and scientific computing tasks.
method: Run hundreds of low-cost agents per round in swarms exploring different approaches.
Select distinct ideas using distances between agents’ hidden-state vectors.
Combine swarm members’ KV caches in a summarizer agent to enable latent-space crossover.
evidence_signal: Across 21 problems, SwarmEvolve achieved the highest average score and reportedly needed a median of 3–8 minutes to match best scores competing frameworks reached in 60 minutes.
watch_item: KV-cache sharing requires access to model internals, which may limit implementation through standard hosted-model APIs.
paper_title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
